releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.65 — pick a background for your chats. (1) Settings ▸ Chats now actually opens: the row that has always said 'Theme, wallpapers, chat history' leads to a wallpaper picker with eight choices — NChat (the default look), Violet, Sunset, Mint, Sky, Sand, Midnight and Graphite. Each tile is the wallpaper itself, so you choose by looking, and a preview panel shows how it sits behind real message bubbles before you commit. The choice applies to every conversation, is stored on this phone only — the other person sees their own — and can be reset to the default at any time. (2) Group chats read better: a sender's name is now drawn once above their run of messages instead of repeating above every single bubble.
